pinyin: zhàn zhe shuō huà bù yāo téng
literal: stand · speak · not · waist · hurt
natural: talking while standing up doesn't hurt the back

meaning.en: It's easy to criticise or advise when you aren't the one doing the hard work.
meaning.zh: 自己不用承担，说起来轻松。

equivalents: easier said than done by someone who isn't doing it

examples.zh: 你站着说话不腰疼，这活儿可不轻松。
examples.en: It's easy for you to talk; the job isn't easy.

examples.zh: 站着说话不腰疼，换你来干干看。
examples.en: It's easy to say from the side; you try doing it.

usage.en: Used to rebuke someone who gives easy advice.
usage.zh: 用来反驳轻松说风凉话的人。

pinyin: guāng jiǎo de bù pà chuān xié de
literal: bare · foot · person · not · fear · shod · person
natural: the barefoot do not fear the shod

meaning.en: Those with nothing to lose are not afraid of those with something to lose.
meaning.zh: 一无所有的人不怕有产业的人。

equivalents: he who has nothing has nothing to lose

examples.zh: 他已经破产了，光脚的不怕穿鞋的，你吓不了他。
examples.en: He's bankrupt and has nothing to lose; you can't scare him.

examples.zh: 光脚的不怕穿鞋的，大公司更怕舆论。
examples.en: Big firms have more to fear from public opinion than those with nothing to lose.

usage.en: Often said of underdogs or desperate opponents.
usage.zh: 常指弱势或破釜沉舟的一方。

pinyin: qīng zhě zì qīng, zhuó zhě zì zhuó
literal: clean · person · self · clean, muddy · person · self · muddy
natural: the clean stay clean and the muddy stay muddy

meaning.en: Innocent people need not defend themselves; the truth will show.
meaning.zh: 清白的人不必辩解，坏人自会暴露。

equivalents: a clear conscience fears no accusation

examples.zh: 别理那些闲话，清者自清，浊者自浊。
examples.en: Ignore the gossip; the clean stay clean.

examples.zh: 清者自清，浊者自浊，时间会证明一切。
examples.en: The clean stay clean; time will tell all.

usage.en: A comforting phrase used to dismiss rumours.
usage.zh: 常用来安慰、驳斥谣言。

pinyin: gōng dào zì zài rén xīn
literal: justice · naturally · lies · in · people's · hearts
natural: justice lives in people's hearts

meaning.en: People know what is fair and right, whatever the official verdict.
meaning.zh: 是非曲直，人们心里自有判断。

equivalents: the court of public opinion knows best
right is right in everyone's heart

examples.zh: 官方怎么说不重要，公道自在人心。
examples.en: What officials say doesn't matter: people know what's fair.

examples.zh: 公道自在人心，群众的眼睛是雪亮的。
examples.en: Justice is in people's hearts; the public sees clearly.

usage.en: Used to assert that truth will be recognised.
usage.zh: 常表示真相终会被认可。

text: 路不平有人踩，事不平有人管
pinyin: lù bù píng yǒu rén cǎi, shì bù píng yǒu rén guǎn
literal: road · not · level · someone · tramples, matter · not · fair · someone · handles
natural: a bumpy road gets trampled flat; an injustice finds someone to put it right

meaning.en: When there is injustice, someone will step forward to correct it.
meaning.zh: 遇到不公平的事，总会有人出来主持公道。

equivalents: where there's injustice, someone will speak up

examples.zh: 路不平有人踩，事不平有人管，我不能装没看见。
examples.en: Injustice will draw someone in; I can't pretend not to see it.

examples.zh: 路不平有人踩，事不平有人管，大家来评评理。
examples.en: Someone will intervene when things are unfair; let everyone judge.

usage.en: Often said by someone intervening on behalf of the wronged.
usage.zh: 多为路见不平者所说。

pinyin: mò qī shào nián qióng
literal: do not · bully · young · person · poor
natural: don't look down on a young man because he is poor

meaning.en: A poor young person may rise to great success later.
meaning.zh: 不要小看年轻时贫穷的人，将来可能大有作为。

equivalents: don't underestimate the young and poor

examples.zh: 莫欺少年穷，他后来成了大老板。
examples.en: Don't scorn the young and poor; he later became a big boss.

examples.zh: 莫欺少年穷，三十年河东，三十年河西。
examples.en: Never scorn a poor young man; fortunes turn.

usage.en: Often followed by 三十年河东，三十年河西.
usage.zh: 常与“三十年河东，三十年河西”连用。

synonyms: 三十年河东，三十年河西

pinyin: xián shí zhì de máng shí yòng
literal: idle · time · prepare · get · busy · time · use
natural: what you prepare in idle times is used in busy ones

meaning.en: Prepare in advance during quiet times so you are ready when needed.
meaning.zh: 空闲时做好准备，忙时就派上用场。

examples.zh: 闲时置得忙时用，趁现在有空把资料整理好。
examples.en: Prepare in quiet times for busy ones; sort the files while we're free.

examples.zh: 闲时置得忙时用，平时多学点技能总没错。
examples.en: Do your prep in idle time; learning more skills never hurts.

usage.en: Advice to prepare ahead of time.
usage.zh: 劝人提前做好准备。

pinyin: luó mǎ bù shì yī tiān jiàn chéng de
literal: Rome · not · is · one · day · built
natural: Rome wasn't built in a day

meaning.en: Great achievements take time and patience.
meaning.zh: 大事业不是一朝一夕能完成的，要有耐心。

equivalents: Rome wasn't built in a day

examples.zh: 别着急，罗马不是一天建成的。
examples.en: Don't be impatient; Rome wasn't built in a day.

examples.zh: 罗马不是一天建成的，练好英语需要时间。
examples.en: Rome wasn't built in a day; learning English takes time.

usage.en: A calque of the English proverb, widely used in Chinese.
usage.zh: 译自英语谚语，汉语中广泛使用。

text: 一根筷子易折，十根筷子难断
pinyin: yī gēn kuài zi yì zhé, shí gēn kuài zi nán duàn
literal: one · chopstick · easy · break, ten · chopsticks · hard · snap
natural: one chopstick breaks easily, ten are hard to snap

meaning.en: There is strength in unity.
meaning.zh: 团结起来力量大。

equivalents: united we stand, divided we fall

examples.zh: 一根筷子易折，十根筷子难断，咱们要团结。
examples.en: One chopstick breaks, ten don't; let's stay united.

examples.zh: 一根筷子易折，十根筷子难断，团队合作才有力量。
examples.en: Unity gives strength.

usage.en: A common image for teamwork and unity.
usage.zh: 常用来说明团结的力量。

pinyin: yī gēn shéng shàng de mà zhà
literal: one · rope · on · 's · grasshopper
natural: grasshoppers on the same string

meaning.en: People bound together by a common fate or interest, for better or worse.
meaning.zh: 利害相关、命运相连的人。

equivalents: to be tarred with the same brush

examples.zh: 你们都是一根绳上的蚂蚱，谁也跑不了。
examples.en: You're all in the same boat; none can escape.

examples.zh: 大家是一根绳上的蚂蚱，要一起想办法。
examples.en: We're all grasshoppers on one string and must work something out together.

usage.en: Usually about bad business or crime; can also be used lightly.
usage.zh: 多用于坏事，也可轻松使用。

text: 一个槽里拴不下两头叫驴
pinyin: yī gè cáo lǐ shuān bù xià liǎng tóu jiào lǘ
literal: one · trough · in · tie · cannot · two · male · donkeys
natural: one trough can't tie up two jackasses

meaning.en: Two strong-willed rivals cannot share one place.
meaning.zh: 两个脾气倔强的人不能共处。

examples.zh: 两个老板脾气都硬，一个槽里拴不下两头叫驴。
examples.en: Both bosses are stubborn and can't share a post.

examples.zh: 一个槽里拴不下两头叫驴，他们迟早要闹翻。
examples.en: Two stubborn people can't share a trough; they'll fall out.

usage.en: Describes rivalry or personality clashes.
usage.zh: 形容性格强硬者之间的矛盾。

pinyin: yī gè bí kǒng chū qì
literal: one · nostril · out · breath
natural: breathing through one nostril

meaning.en: To be of one mind, usually in a bad cause; to collude.
meaning.zh: 意见完全一致，多指串通一气。

equivalents: to sing from the same hymn sheet

examples.zh: 他们俩一个鼻孔出气，肯定有勾结。
examples.en: They are in cahoots and surely colluding.

examples.zh: 别和他一个鼻孔出气，你得有自己的判断。
examples.en: Don't just parrot him; use your own judgement.

usage.en: Derogatory; used of collusion or blind agreement.
usage.zh: 贬义，指串通或盲目附和。

pinyin: sān gè nǚ rén yī tái xì
literal: three · women · one · stage · play
natural: three women make a theatre show

meaning.en: A group of women chatting makes a lot of noise and fuss (a stereotyped, humorous saying).
meaning.zh: 几个女人聚在一起就很热闹。

equivalents: women together make a lively show

examples.zh: 三个女人一台戏，她们聊起来没完。
examples.en: Three women make a show; they chat on endlessly.

examples.zh: 办公室里三个女人一台戏，天天都有新话题。
examples.en: There's always something new to talk about in the office.

usage.en: Humorous and stereotyped; some consider it dated.
usage.zh: 戏谑，有刻板印象，有人认为不妥。

pinyin: qiān jīn nán mǎi yī xiào
literal: thousand · gold · hard · buy · one · smile
natural: a thousand pieces of gold can't buy a smile

meaning.en: A genuine smile or happiness is priceless.
meaning.zh: 真正的笑容和快乐无法用金钱买到。

examples.zh: 看孩子笑得这么开心，真是千金难买一笑。
examples.en: Seeing the child laugh so happily, a smile is priceless.

examples.zh: 千金难买一笑，她终于露出了笑容。
examples.en: A thousand gold couldn't buy that smile; she finally smiled.

usage.en: Also used of a person willing to pay anything to see a loved one smile.
usage.zh: 也指为博红颜一笑不惜重金。

pinyin: qiān jīn nán mǎi hòu huǐ yào
literal: thousand · gold · hard · buy · regret · medicine
natural: no amount of gold buys a cure for regret

meaning.en: Once a mistake is made, it cannot be undone.
meaning.zh: 事后再后悔也无法挽回。

equivalents: it's no use crying over spilt milk

examples.zh: 千金难买后悔药，做决定前要想清楚。
examples.en: Think before deciding; there's no pill for regret.

examples.zh: 他后悔当初没读书，可千金难买后悔药。
examples.en: He regrets not studying, but no gold can buy that back.

usage.en: Often a warning to think before acting.
usage.zh: 常提醒人三思而行。

pinyin: yī bǎ yào shí kāi yī bǎ suǒ
literal: one · key · opens · one · lock
natural: one key opens one lock

meaning.en: Different problems need different solutions.
meaning.zh: 不同的问题要用不同的方法解决。

equivalents: different problems call for different solutions
one size does not fit all

examples.zh: 一把钥匙开一把锁，每个学生的教法都不同。
examples.en: Each student needs a different approach.

examples.zh: 一把钥匙开一把锁，不能用同一个办法对付所有问题。
examples.en: One key opens one lock; you can't use one method for every problem.

usage.en: Advises case-by-case thinking.
usage.zh: 提倡具体问题具体分析。

pinyin: bù pà guān, zhǐ pà guǎn
literal: not · fear · official, only · fear · supervisor
natural: one doesn't fear an official, only the one who has direct charge

meaning.en: People fear the one who directly controls them, not a distant high official.
meaning.zh: 怕的是直接管着自己的人，而不是官位高的人。

equivalents: fear the boss who has direct authority

examples.zh: 不怕官，只怕管，真正能卡你的是直属领导。
examples.en: It's your direct supervisor who really controls you.

examples.zh: 不怕官，只怕管，办事还得找对部门。
examples.en: You must find the right department.

usage.en: Often used about bureaucracy and direct supervisors.
usage.zh: 常指现管的单位或直属上级。

pinyin: lái de zǎo bù rú lái de qiǎo
literal: come · early · not · as good as · come · well-timed
natural: better to arrive at the right moment than early

meaning.en: Good timing counts for more than being early.
meaning.zh: 来得及时比来得早更重要。

equivalents: better late than never; it's all about timing

examples.zh: 你们刚好赶上开饭，来得早不如来得巧。
examples.en: You arrived just in time for dinner; right timing beats being early.

examples.zh: 来得早不如来得巧，我们正好需要人手。
examples.en: Perfect timing; we need extra hands.

usage.en: Said to a guest who arrives at an opportune moment.
usage.zh: 多对恰好赶上的人说。

text: 刀不磨要生锈，人不学要落后
pinyin: dāo bù mó yào shēng xiù, rén bù xué yào luò hòu
literal: knife · not · whet · will · rust, person · not · study · will · fall · behind
natural: an unsharpened knife rusts, an unstudying person falls behind

meaning.en: Keep studying or you will be left behind.
meaning.zh: 不学习就会被时代淘汰。

equivalents: a rolling stone gathers no moss

examples.zh: 刀不磨要生锈，人不学要落后，要坚持学习。
examples.en: Keep studying; a blade unsharpened rusts.

examples.zh: 刀不磨要生锈，人不学要落后，工作后也要学习。
examples.en: A knife unsharpened rusts and people who don't learn fall behind, even after starting work.

usage.en: Often used in training and school slogans.
usage.zh: 常见于培训和教育标语。

synonyms: 学如逆水行舟，不进则退

pinyin: bāo zi yǒu ròu bù zài zhě shàng
literal: bun · has · meat · not · in · pleats · on
natural: a bun's meat isn't in its pleats

meaning.en: Real ability doesn't depend on appearances or showy talk.
meaning.zh: 真正的本事不在外表和夸夸其谈。

equivalents: don't judge a book by its cover

examples.zh: 包子有肉不在褶上，他虽然话少，办事却很靠谱。
examples.en: He says little but is reliable: it's what's inside that counts.

examples.zh: 包子有肉不在褶上，别光看外表。
examples.en: Don't judge by looks alone.

usage.en: A folksy way to say substance beats form.
usage.zh: 形象地说明内在比外表重要。

pinyin: yǎo rén de gǒu bù lù chǐ
literal: bite · people · 's · dog · not · show · teeth
natural: a biting dog doesn't bare its teeth

meaning.en: Those who plot harm usually hide their intentions and look harmless.
meaning.zh: 真正要害人的人不动声色。

examples.zh: 咬人的狗不露齿，对安静的对手要多加防备。
examples.en: A biting dog shows no teeth; guard against quiet rivals.

examples.zh: 咬人的狗不露齿，越是客气的人越要小心。
examples.en: Be wary of the overly polite.

usage.en: Similar to 会咬人的狗不叫.
usage.zh: 与“会咬人的狗不叫”相近。

text: 单丝不成线，独木不成林
pinyin: dān sī bù chéng xiàn, dú mù bù chéng lín
literal: single · thread · not · make · string, lone · tree · not · make · forest
natural: a single thread makes no string, a lone tree no forest

meaning.en: One person alone cannot achieve much; unity is strength.
meaning.zh: 一个人的力量有限，需要团结合作。

equivalents: one swallow doesn't make a summer

examples.zh: 单丝不成线，独木不成林，我们需要团队。
examples.en: A single thread is no cord; we need a team.

examples.zh: 单丝不成线，独木不成林，别想着单打独斗。
examples.en: Don't try to go it alone.

usage.en: Often in team-building or community contexts.
usage.zh: 常用于强调团队合作。

pinyin: zuǐ shàng méi máo, bàn shì bù láo
literal: mouth · on · no · hair, handle · matters · not · firm
natural: no hair on the lip, work isn't reliable

meaning.en: Young people lack experience so their work cannot be trusted.
meaning.zh: 年轻人经验不足，做事不可靠。

examples.zh: 嘴上没毛，办事不牢，老板不放心让他独立负责。
examples.en: The boss doesn't trust him to be in charge on his own.

examples.zh: 别说嘴上没毛，办事不牢，年轻人也有长处。
examples.en: Don't dismiss young people; they have strengths.

usage.en: Said of the young, usually with disdain; the young often cite it ironically.
usage.zh: 多带轻视，年轻人有时自嘲式引用。

text: 在家千日好，出门一时难
pinyin: zài jiā qiān rì hǎo, chū mén yī shí nán
literal: at · home · thousand · days · good, go out · one · moment · hard
natural: a thousand days at home are good, a moment away is hard

meaning.en: Home is comfortable; travel brings difficulty.
meaning.zh: 在家总是舒服，出门在外困难多。

examples.zh: 在家千日好，出门一时难，他想家了。
examples.en: There's no place like home; he's homesick.

examples.zh: 在家千日好，出门一时难，出门前要做好准备。
examples.en: Prepare well before travelling.

usage.en: Often used by travellers or about being away.
usage.zh: 常用于旅行或在外时的感叹。

synonyms: 金窝银窝不如自己的草窝

pinyin: chā zhī háo lí, shī zhī qiān lǐ
literal: differ · by · hair · tiny measure, lose · by · thousand · miles
natural: a hair's breadth off at the start means a thousand miles lost

meaning.en: A tiny error at the start leads to a huge mistake in the end.
meaning.zh: 开始时的小误差，最后会造成大错。

equivalents: a miss is as good as a mile

examples.zh: 差之毫厘，失之千里，数据录入一定要仔细。
examples.en: A hair's breadth of error becomes a thousand miles; be careful with data entry.

examples.zh: 差之毫厘，失之千里，航天任务不能有任何失误。
examples.en: Space missions allow no error.

usage.en: Often used for precise fields: science, engineering, accounting.
usage.zh: 常用于科学、工程、会计等需要精确的领域。
